We primarily attract customers through feedback and referrals. <Commercial Land Acquisition> Our primary focus is acquiring commercial land for apartment complexes (condominiums and row houses). We build relationships with business partners and real estate brokerages, quickly obtain fresh land information before it hits the market, and are responsible for the entire process from concluding a sales contract. Although we mainly deal with apartment sites, we are also flexible and proactively pursue the acquisition of land for profitable business purposes such as hotels, office buildings, commercial facilities, and condominiums.

Description: [Gain consistent work experience from purchasing land for single-family homes, to planning, sales promotion, and after-sales support.] ■ Specific Job Description ・ Obtain land information from real estate agents ・ Inspect the land and conduct research at the relevant government offices to confirm the surrounding environment and legal restrictions ・ Negotiate purchasing with the agent ・ Plan the land zoning and the home you want to build ・ Provide information to the agent and have them find a buyer while construction is underway ・ Once a buyer is found, handle the contract and handover ・ Provide after-sales support (repairs) if any problems arise in the buyer's home after handover [About Our Company] (Company website: https://www.hawk-one.jp/) Hawk One is a single-family home manufacturer primarily serving Tokyo, Kanagawa, Chiba, Saitama, and Aichi. We specialize in high-quality, comfortable, and safe homes at reasonable prices. We specialize in new styles of homebuilding, such as pioneering the industry with our proposed-planned homes. This year, we achieved our highest sales since our founding, reaching 146.1 billion yen, demonstrating steady growth. Meanwhile, over the past three years, our average overtime hours have been 21.5 hours, roughly one hour per day, allowing for a stylish work style. While the industry average exceeds 35 hours, we prioritize work-life balance and create a comfortable working environment. [About the Planning and Sales Position] This position is not simply a sales position selling automation and packaged products. Rather, it is a core position for our company, where you will be involved as a "total housing producer" from land procurement to planning the home you want to build from scratch. [Position Appeal 1: Gain "Experience" Beyond Sales] Planning and Sales involves every step of the homebuilding process, from purchasing land to creating plans such as floor plans and designs, developing sales strategies, and providing after-sales service. While working in sales, you will gain comprehensive experience in homebuilding, thereby acquiring overwhelming expertise and a wide range of knowledge and know-how in real estate. [Position Appeal 2: The rewarding feeling of knowing that the home you designed will support your customers' lives] One of the joys of planning and sales is coming up with a plan that maximizes the value of the land, down to the floor plan, design, and every single material. You will anticipate the home and lifestyle that the people who will live on the land you have purchased will be looking for, and plan the home, including the location of the living room, the size of the parking lot, etc. Also, when showing customers the completed home, you can explain and interact with them with love because it is a home that you have thought about and built yourself, and you will feel joy and satisfaction working together with the customer.

Description: Based on a meritocracy, we reward hard work with incentives. Career advancement is extremely rapid, making this the perfect environment for those who want to continue building their careers! We also offer comprehensive benefits and allowances to ensure employees can work with us for many years with peace of mind. This is a proposal-based sales role supporting office relocations for small and medium-sized enterprises, venture companies, and startups. Since the sales representatives are management, our sales style is more like a consulting business that delves into management issues rather than simply introducing properties. [Workflow] ▼ Customer Acquisition └ We use a variety of methods, including responding to inquiries, repeat business with past clients, referrals, and social media, to connect with companies considering office relocations. Uncovering potential needs through telephone and cold calling is also an important part of the job. ▼ Interviews (Identifying Issues) └ We carefully listen to each client's unique background and desired conditions, such as "crowded space due to increased staff" or "relocating to a location with good access." By listening in-depth to the business phase and organizational structure, we are able to uncover their fundamental issues. Each salesperson handles approximately 50 to 80 potential clients at a time. (This includes not only ongoing negotiations, but also clients who cannot be contacted, clients who have already closed deals with other companies, and clients whose consideration has been suspended.) ▼ Property Introductions and Viewings └ We propose the most suitable property based on the interviews we conduct. We also accompany you on on-site viewings. We check not only the property's size and facilities, but also the surrounding environment and visitor flow. We handle a wide range of properties, from small properties under ¥100,000 to large properties costing nearly ¥10 million. (Rent rates vary depending on the area and purpose.) ▼ Application and Contract Adjustments └ We prepare application forms, negotiate terms with the owner, and adjust contracts. We aim for a smooth contract conclusion while taking into consideration the perspectives of both the tenant and landlord. ▼ Contract to Relocation and Aftercare └ Even after the contract is signed, we provide support for the transfer and relocation preparations (interior design, communication lines, etc.). We will also respond to inquiries regarding usability after the move and build long-term relationships with you.

Description: 90% of our sales department is in their 20s and joined the company with no prior experience! Our senior colleagues, all close in age, are very frank and caring. Rather than rivals competing for results, we foster a friendly working environment where employees are like colleagues who strive to improve. Because we've been active since joining the company with no prior experience, we can provide guidance from an equal perspective, ensuring a highly repeatable progression. We offer incentives for each successful sale, and employees who complete three sales within three months have the opportunity to be promoted. Even if an employee only secures an appointment and has their supervisor negotiate the deal, we still offer incentives if the deal is successful. We also offer a variety of employee benefits to support employee health. For example, our company cafeteria offers meals starting at 100 yen. Fresh salads and fruit, additive-free and domestically sourced prepared foods, and protein-rich "Kinniku Shokudo" bento boxes are available. We also have vending machines with drinks starting at 50 yen, eliminating the need to go to the convenience store. After joining the company, you will undergo training including role-playing before taking on sales roles. Our company develops properties that meet the specifications required for investment apartments and offers them in convenient locations near train stations. You will be working on proposing the rental management of these apartments. Recently, awareness of this type of apartment management has increased, and more people are considering it. Sales activities involve obtaining appointments through telephone inquiries, street surveys, and referrals. Once an appointment is secured, you will visit the customer and negotiate. Our target audience is general business people. Visible results, such as appointments, contracts, and payments, offer promotion opportunities for employees who complete three payments within three months, providing ample opportunities for fulfillment. Therefore, by working with a goal in mind, we offer an environment where even junior employees can grow as much as they want. [After joining the company: 2 months - 1 year] Under the guidance of senior employees, you will learn etiquette, courtesy, and business skills as a working professional. [2 months - 1 year] The average first order takes 3 months. With experienced senior colleagues close by, you can consult with them immediately. [After the first year] Depending on your performance, you will be promoted and entrusted with mentoring junior colleagues. [Company trips] ・Bali, Indonesia in 2016! ・Bangkok, Thailand in February 2018! ・Cebu in November 2018! ・Ishigaki Island in November 2019! ・Okinawa in October 2022! ・Da Nang, Vietnam in July 2023! ・We went to Taiwan in November 2024! ・Annual incentive trips: This is a system in which top performers go on a two-night trip! (We went to Thailand in 2016, Okinawa main island from 2017 to 2019, and Miyakojima in 2022!)

Description: \No cold calls, 100% response-based sales!/ We receive a great response, and most of our customers contact us after seeing our web ads or flyers! We don't use cold calls, prospecting, or hard sales techniques! We offer a comfortable work environment, even for first-time sales professionals! You will be responsible for consulting on reducing power costs and proposing energy-saving equipment to business companies. [Specific Duties] You will start as an inside sales representative and may transition to field sales as appropriate. ▼Inside Sales: ・Conduct interviews on power cost situations ・Create appointments by proposing improvements ・Nurture prospective customers ▼Field Sales: ・Conduct sales negotiations (checking electricity usage, proposing cost reductions, negotiating) ・Create proposal materials tailored to customer challenges and budgets based on interview information ・Draft and handle contract signing ・Propose upselling and cross-selling to existing customers (approximately 3 sales meetings per day) Products handled: Company equipment-related products (LEDs, air conditioners, solar panels, etc.) No individual quotas. Description: You will be responsible for response sales to customers considering home remodeling. Inquiries will come from those who saw our website or flyers, as well as repeat customers and referrals. This is 100% response sales, and there are no cold calls or telemarketing calls, so even those with no experience can start with confidence. [Specific Job Description] ■ Inquiry Handling: We respond to inquiries from customers who saw our flyers or website, re-readers, and referrals. We visit customers' homes and inspect the site, listening to their requests, such as "what they want to fix and how." ■ Planning: We bring the information back to the company and create the optimal plan. In consultation with senior staff, we create a remodeling plan and estimate tailored to the customer's needs. 60-70% of customers close the deal (compared to the industry average of 20-30%). ■ Construction Progress Management: We coordinate construction schedules and arrange for craftsmen and materials. As the site manager, you will monitor progress and follow up with customers and craftsmen during construction. After handover, you will regularly follow up to ensure customer satisfaction. [After Hiring] We provide 2-3 months of training. This is a fun course for anyone who loves craftsmanship. We teach you step-by-step, starting with the basics, so you can easily apply what you learn in the workplace. While there's a lot to learn at first, even those with no experience can become fully-fledged in about one to two years. [Career Path] We evaluate employees based on their performance, regardless of whether they're new graduates, mid-career (experienced or inexperienced), age at the time of joining, or gender. Some employees can become store managers as early as four to six years after joining. Promotional Points: Renovations are completed in partnership with customers. That's why the genuine "thank you" you receive when you create something great is the most rewarding part of this job. Once you become a trusted customer, you may even be asked for advice on new renovations or referred to relatives and friends. [Your Hard Work is Well Rewarded!] Our company offers rapid career advancement and increased earnings. Most of our store managers, including female store managers in their 20s, joined the company with no prior experience. [About the Company] We're seeing steady growth due to the growing demand for renovations and our growing name recognition. With numerous stores across Japan, new store plans are currently underway. We will continue to grow even further in the future. The purpose of this recruitment is to strengthen our organization in order to achieve the above. We provide training to turn inexperienced people into professionals! We look forward to your application to join our company, which combines stability and growth.

In addition to office space brokerage, we also focus on welfare tenant brokerage, contributing to solving social issues and leading to future business expansion. ■Job Summary: Doctors considering opening a clinic each have their own aspirations and challenges. In this position, you will support these clients as a start-up partner by selecting and brokering properties, coordinating with alliance partners, managing the schedule leading up to opening, and providing various advice. You will be involved in all processes related to opening a clinic, helping managers realize their dreams. Specific tasks include: ▼ Customer Acquisition └ Utilizing a variety of methods, including responding to inquiries, repeat business from previous clients, referrals, and social media, you will connect with clinics and doctors considering relocating or opening a new clinic. ▼ Interviews (Identifying Issues) └ We carefully listen to each client's unique background and desired conditions, such as "I want to relocate to a location with good access" or "I want to set up my own clinic." By listening in-depth to the business phase and organizational structure, we can uncover the underlying issues. ▼ Property Introductions and Viewings └ We propose the most suitable property based on the interviews. We also accompany you on on-site viewings. We check not only the property's size and facilities, but also the surrounding environment and visitor flow. We handle a wide range of properties, from small properties under ¥300,000 to large properties costing nearly ¥10 million. (Market rents vary depending on the area and purpose.) ▼ Application and Contract Adjustments └ We prepare application forms, negotiate terms with the owner, and adjust contracts. We aim to smoothly conclude contracts while taking into consideration the positions of both the tenant and the landlord. ▼ Contracts and follow-up support (opening support) └ There are many tasks to complete before opening a clinic, from developing a clinic concept to formulating and implementing a financing plan, deciding on interior design and medical equipment, and handling applications to the public health center. We will support you in opening your ideal clinic while building long-term relationships. Promotional Points [Attractive Points of the Position] Negotiating primarily with clinic directors (i.e., managers) and senior executives. You will be on the front lines of management, witnessing rapid decision-making and business growth, and engaging in dialogue on an equal footing. While expectations are high, this environment will significantly enhance your perspective and market value. The experience of working closely with managers will be a valuable asset that can be used in any industry. Furthermore, by supporting doctors through their growth phases and building trust, you may receive specific requests, such as "I want you to open my next clinic too." The real joy of this job is feeling truly needed as a business partner. [Rewarding Points of the Job] For doctors, opening a clinic is a major, once-in-a-lifetime decision. As someone who supports these challenges, it is rewarding to receive words of gratitude directly. On the other hand, the doctors I interact with are highly specialized and knowledgeable. By working on highly challenging projects, I naturally acquire specialized knowledge of the medical industry, management, and marketing, and it is a position where I can feel my own growth every day.

Description: ■Job Description You will be responsible for end-to-end sales planning, purchasing used homes from the market, renovating them to look like new homes, and offering them to customers. Working backwards from the exit point, you will consider factors such as "target, renovation details, and sales price," and develop sales strategies (hypotheses) from the purchasing stage. This process will hone versatile skills, including business management. ■Specific Duties (1) Purchasing You will build relationships with local real estate agents and receive introductions from them. Once introduced, you will proceed with the purchasing process, following the steps of on-site property viewing (inspection) ⇒ obtaining pricing information ⇒ internal appraisal (negotiations with the appraisal department) ⇒ sales negotiations ⇒ contract and settlement. You will inspect approximately 8-10 properties per month, ultimately resulting in approximately 2-3 contracts. (2) Renovation You will work with an external renovation company to plan the sales price and renovation details to suit local demand and the needs of your target customers. Because used homes are unique, the floor plan and design will vary depending on the property's condition and market conditions. You will create new value for pre-owned homes through plans that take into consideration the customers who will live in them. This will involve remodeling and refurbishment only, not large-scale renovations. You will acquire housing knowledge through training after joining the company. (3) Sales: After remodeling, you will consider how to sell the property, post it on portal sites, and begin sales activities. After receiving inquiries from real estate agents and general customers who have been asked to represent them in sales activities, you will show the home. The process involves interviewing agents and customers, making proposals that meet their needs, and then signing and paying the contract, with the aim of closing the deal. You will be responsible for approximately 5-10 properties, receiving approximately 20 inquiries per month, and ultimately closing approximately 2-3 deals. *It is important to work backwards from the exit point, considering factors such as "purchasing target/renovation details/sales price," and considering sales estimates (hypotheses) from the purchasing stage. This allows employees to grow rapidly, with an average of three to four years after joining the company. *Examples of mid-career hires: Food & Beverage, Wedding Planner, Apparel, etc. ■Attractiveness of the Job You will imagine the lifestyles of our customers and be involved in the entire process from purchasing to sales. Through this process, you will hone a wide range of skills, including marketing thinking, planning ability, and proposal skills. This job brings great joy when your strategies and hypotheses work and your customers are satisfied. ■Workstyle In addition to 120 days of annual leave (Tuesdays and Wednesdays), we offer a "Positive Change System" that allows you to transfer your days off to any day of the week twice a month. We value clear communication of the reasons for every action, asking questions like, "What do I want to do?", "Why?", and "What impact will this have in the future?" We work closely with departments to communicate not only our own work but also the role each task plays for the company. As you become more familiar with other tasks, you'll be tasked with planning customer acquisition methods, managing social media accounts, and implementing video streaming. Rest assured, these tasks will be gradually assigned to you based on your individual experience. Of course, you can also be entrusted with all tasks from the start, depending on your needs and experience! ◎External training participation is welcome. Description: [Assigned Work] You will visit real estate companies that handle commercial properties, such as offices and stores, and promote the use of the company's rent guarantee service (Biz Guarantee). You will visit existing and new real estate agents in our group companies to propose the guarantee service! [About the Client] While it is the property tenants who sign the rent guarantee contract, it is the real estate agents themselves who will approach them. Since our group companies already have approximately 1,000 clients, you will initially be tasked with conducting route sales to real estate agents with whom we have agency agreements. Traditionally, rent guarantees have focused on residential properties, but recently there has been growing interest in business properties within the industry, making this a field with a promising future. [Desired candidate] Regularly visiting clients and having the communication skills to build good relationships is extremely important! Promotional points [Complete mid-career training program, no need to worry, even if you have no experience] The first three months after joining the company will be a training period, where you will gradually gain know-how through a mix of classroom learning and practical experience! Description: ■Job Description: After receiving a request, you will be tasked with conducting a "complete response sales" role, visiting customers' homes and making reuse proposals. Because we have grown to the point where we receive 40,000 monthly purchase requests, the largest in the industry, we never conduct cold calls or make cold calls. Even those with no experience can feel at ease and focus on building trust with customers and mastering their sales skills. [Specific Job Details] ・Proposing reuse for items desired for purchase └Visiting customers' homes to confirm the condition of the items and redefining their value ・Confirming the condition of the items and determining the price and providing an estimate └Obtaining required information from customers, the system will automatically calculate market value, etc. Estimated number of visits per day: 3-5 (depending on the number of cases that day) While the role of a buyer may sound daunting, our field sales team is unique in that they are able to provide additional value to customers. By listening to what motivated them to sell the requested items, we can provide value that customers themselves may not have realized. These hidden assets are said to be worth 66 trillion yen, making this a win-win-win business model. ■Features Our company handles over 30 product categories, allowing us to offer comprehensive proposals that would be impossible with a single-item business model. We are strategically expanding our product categories and actively developing new businesses in the reuse field. Depending on your performance, you may have the opportunity to be involved in new businesses, and we offer an environment where you can build a career that suits your aspirations, either from 1 to 10 or 0 to 1. Promotional Points [About Market Enterprise] Our company is a reuse venture founded in 2006. We launched after much trial and error, seeking to create a unique business model for the secondhand market, which was once dominated by recycle shops. Since our founding, we have steadily grown, currently receiving 40,000 monthly purchase requests, the largest in the industry. Driven by the growth of e-commerce in society, the company is committed to further expansion by focusing on the rapidly growing online reuse business. Recently, we have been promoting "toG business," following on from "toC business" and "toB business." The "G" stands for "Government," and we are working with government agencies on SDGs. Market Enterprise has attracted attention not only from individuals and companies but also from government agencies, and has numerous partnerships. Because our business itself contributes greatly to society, the job is highly rewarding. [Challenge and growth from inexperienced individuals realized through initiative] Our company can be best described in one word: "initiative." This is not simply a corporate culture; personal growth is always linked to the company's growth. Even a single year is packed with learning opportunities, and there is constant change, with new business launches and new base openings. Set in a growing industry, we offer a culture of challenge where young employees are given significant discretion and can grow together with their colleagues at an incredible pace. This environment, where seniority is not a given, naturally offers significant discretion and opportunities to members who demonstrate initiative. Regardless of length of employment or experience, we believe that experience in taking charge and getting things done is what's important, and senior employees will support you as a team. [The process for those with no experience in a different industry to acquire sales skills and flourish] 99% of our current employees started with no experience, but they have grown by fully utilizing the discretion they are given. After joining, they undergo a two-month training program. In addition to classroom learning, new employees hone their sales skills by accompanying senior employees on sales trips and receiving on-the-job training. We also offer a 1,000-page manual to help educate inexperienced employees from the ground up. Rest assured, we will assign tasks to employees based on their skills and experience. ・In their second year, even those with no experience can become assistant branch managers at age 24. ・In their third year, even those with no experience can become branch managers at age 25. ・From their fourth year onwards, there are opportunities to advance to the next career step, such as being promoted to branch manager. Because we value everyone equally, regardless of age or experience, there are opportunities for new hires, even if you join now.

Description: We are a developer specializing in single-family homes and rental apartments, and we handle everything from land acquisition to sales. In addition to newly built single-family homes, single-family apartments, and new homes, we also engage in a variety of housing and lifestyle-related projects to contribute to a more comfortable social life for people of all generations. For example, we are involved in areas unrelated to real estate, such as early childhood education, support for child welfare facilities, and support for the elderly. Since becoming independent from the Shin-Nihon Tatemono Group in 2010, we have operated our business with a small but elite team. Now, as we enter our second phase of growth, we welcome new members and look forward to continuing our growth. [Job Description] ・Procurement and sales promotion of land for development projects such as newly built single-family homes and single-family apartments ・Business promotion for commercialized properties PR Points: We plan to be listed on the Tokyo Pro Market in 2023. We are entering our second phase of growth as a comprehensive real estate developer. [Recruitment Background] Currently, our business is focused on the development of studio apartments, single-family homes, and residential land. In addition to these core businesses, we are expanding into residential and commercial mixed-use development, real estate revitalization, ESG, and lifestyle-related businesses. We have also moved to a new office as we enter our second founding period. Now that we have expanded our workforce, we are now recruiting new members. As we continue to grow, we still have key positions open. We welcome you to take on a central role in the company. In this growing environment, we are seeking individuals who are eager to grow and gain experience in a wide range of real estate. [Attractions and Recommended Points] <Breadth of Work> Each individual will be responsible for everything from purchasing to future purchases. The entire department works together to achieve our sales targets. Our primary business is purchasing land for single-family apartment buildings, approximately 80 to 130 sq. m (25 to 40 sq. m), five-story buildings without elevators. The primary role involves obtaining information from real estate agents and negotiating contracts. Our studio apartments primarily target low- and mid-rise apartments that other companies are not involved in. Not only will you be able to utilize your purchasing knowledge, but you'll also gain new knowledge, becoming a versatile land purchasing specialist and gaining a high level of knowledge and experience in the upstream real estate process. Description: Primarily information on referral routes from partner companies in Fukuoka (tax accountants, lawyers, judicial scriveners, financial institutions, insurance companies, etc.)! We're looking for people in their 20s and 30s looking to gain a wide range of knowledge and experience! You'll be primarily responsible for brokerage work on income-generating real estate sales and purchases within a team responsible for the brokerage business. First, you'll learn the process of income-generating real estate sales and purchases through on-the-job training with on-site employees. After that, you'll also be involved in the asset business operations of our parent company, Good Real Estate Co., Ltd. (concurrent position). Depending on your aspirations and aptitude, you'll eventually lead the business as the main person in charge or manager of the asset business. Income-generating real estate sales and purchases brokerage position You'll be primarily responsible for brokerage work on income-generating real estate sales and purchases within a team responsible for the brokerage business. [Specific Responsibilities] ・Approaching owners and related parties of income-generating real estate ・All contract and delivery procedures related to the brokerage and purchase of income-generating real estate ・Planning and developing our in-house brand apartment "Giraffe Series" ・Planning value-enhancing properties for resale, and developing and managing resale strategies ・Product development and management for the real estate crowdfunding platform "Beginners Cloud" etc. *You will not be handling everything on your own; you will work collaboratively with related departments, group companies, and business partners. The asset business primarily focuses on planning and management. What Makes This Job Special? Philosophy and Vision Our mission is to "connect hearts, connect smiles, and connect happiness." Modern society has become a convenient place, with the spread of the internet and social media, allowing anyone to connect with anyone and access the information they need. However, these platforms are also rife with inaccurate information and insensitive comments, exposing people to emotional pain through connection. In this society, issues related to real estate sales and inheritance can sometimes cause significant stress and affect family bonds. Our mission is to ease the burden on our customers and bring them peace of mind and joy. We chose the name "Good Real Estate Consulting" because we want to solve all of our customers' concerns, not just be a real estate sales and purchase company. We promise to bring smiles and happiness to as many customers as possible through proposals for homes and income-generating properties and support for inheritance issues. Business: We fully utilize the group's resources and connections cultivated as a comprehensive real estate service company. Founded in 2023, we took over the sales and purchase brokerage business of Good Real Estate Co., Ltd. and the asset consulting business of Mitsuha Home, operated by the Mitsuha Group Legal Scriveners. Both companies have long focused on real estate management and asset management. By combining their respective track records and expertise, we have been able to not only strengthen our sales and purchase brokerage and resale businesses, but also provide a wide range of services, including asset consulting services such as inheritance and wills. In addition to the owners and business partners of our parent company, Good Real Estate, we have a strong track record of building strong relationships with various corporations in the Fukuoka area, including tax accountants, financial institutions, insurance companies, and lawyers. This is a unique strength of Good Real Estate Consulting. Our parent company, Good Real Estate, owns potentially valuable real estate, primarily in Fukuoka City, and is engaged in an asset business aimed at creating new value and revitalizing it into prime assets. By fully utilizing the resources we've cultivated as a comprehensive real estate service provider, we aim to maximize real estate value while contributing to society through our keen perspective on property potential and our planning capabilities, which include development, revitalization, and fractionalization. We value the Good Real Estate Group's management philosophy of "common sense and trust" and our commitment to our customers. We welcome honest, adventurous individuals who value growth and can grow together with us! Our Workforce and Corporate Culture: When you think of "real estate," you might imagine a traditional paper-based culture, a sports-oriented work environment, hectic work schedules, and strict hierarchical relationships. However, our IT-infused work environment, well-balanced work styles, and active, open-minded employee environment allow young people and women to thrive, resulting in a high employee retention rate. Salary & Benefits: Start with confidence, even with no experience. A career path with overwhelming growth through qualification acquisition and job rotation! ■ Comprehensive support for qualification acquisition! We believe that hardworking, dedicated individuals who strive to be of service to our customers will grow both personally and professionally. We fully support career advancement and offer allowances to those who obtain the necessary qualifications for the job. There are 16 eligible qualifications, and those with a real estate license will receive a monthly allowance of 15,000 yen! Many of our employees hold first- and second-class architect licenses and demonstrate their abilities in specialized fields. This environment allows you to acquire advanced knowledge and know-how, making it an ideal environment for those seeking to further their current level of expertise. ■ Steady improvement in daily work and job rotation to challenge yourself! We have built a solid foundation in the industry, built on the trust of our long-standing owners. Our track record and know-how are highly valued, and we continue to grow steadily. We have implemented a 360° evaluation system, and we want to see not just sales figures, but also "people who work sincerely and achieve results" gain as much experience as possible. In fact, we have a senior employee who was promoted to sales manager in his second year at the company, and then to chief three years later! We also implement job rotations while listening to individual requests. In the future, you can change careers to work in Tokyo, Osaka, or Nagoya, or work in renovations or sales intermediation, depending on your wishes. Please feel free to tell us about your future aspirations during regular interviews with your supervisor!

Description: [Position] Construction Manager [Job Description] You will be responsible for all construction management tasks for buildings or civil engineering structures. Specifically, you will be engaged in the following tasks: ・Process management: └ Creating the overall construction schedule, managing progress, and planning and implementing measures to prevent delays ・Quality control: └ Checking construction quality based on design documents, inspections, and providing guidance for quality improvement ・Safety management: └ Site safety patrols, correcting dangerous areas, formulating and implementing safety and health plans, and taking measures to prevent accidents ・Cost management: └ Budget management, optimizing material and labor costs, and analyzing variances from the actual budget ・Coordination with partner companies: └ Meeting with companies, giving instructions, and coordinating work ・Document preparation: └ Preparing construction plans, various reports, organizing photos, etc. *Changes in job content: None Promotional Points [Attractive Points] 1. A sense of accomplishment from work that will remain on the map One of the greatest attractions of a construction managerial position is that the buildings and infrastructure you have worked on remain tangible, supporting the lives of many people as work that will remain on the map. The sense of accomplishment and fulfillment you feel when you see a completed building, road, or bridge is something you rarely experience in other jobs. The realization that the project you're involved in contributes to society is a major motivator. 2. Acquire a wide range of knowledge and skills. Construction management requires a wide range of knowledge and skills, including architecture, civil engineering, electricity, machinery, and ICT. In addition to specialized skills such as process management, quality control, safety management, and cost management, you'll also develop communication skills to work smoothly with many stakeholders, problem-solving skills to deal with unexpected issues, and leadership skills to oversee the entire site. There are many opportunities to constantly be exposed to new technologies and regulations, making this a job where you can easily experience personal growth. 3. The joy of project management. Construction management is like the "command center" on a construction site. Based on blueprints, you work with people from various positions, including craftsmen, partner companies, and clients, to guide a project to completion. While things may not always go as planned, the joy of overcoming difficulties and successfully completing a project is all the more intense. You'll find the process of working with many people to create something from scratch fascinating. 4. Stable Demand and Career Path: Social infrastructure development and building maintenance and renovation are always needed, so there's a very steady demand for construction managers. Furthermore, with experience, you can advance to more responsible positions such as site supervisor or site manager, or even consider going independent in the future. Obtaining certifications (such as construction management engineer) can enhance your expertise and further increase your market value. 5. The Joy of Achieving as a Team: Construction management is not a solo job. Many professionals, including designers, craftsmen, representatives from partner companies, and material manufacturers, work together toward a common goal. The sense of community and joy you feel when you pool your wisdom, overcome challenges, and achieve your goals is a unique attraction of this job. [Company Appeal] 1. Support System: Each salesperson is responsible for approximately 10 to 20 people, allowing for detailed support. (*The average at other companies is that one salesperson is responsible for around 70-100 people.) 2. Career Change As the Babel Group operates across a wide range of businesses, it is possible to switch to an in-house position or change careers to positions other than construction management. [Recruitment Background] With the economic recovery and increased demand for urban development and infrastructure development, many new architectural and civil engineering projects are being planned, and the number of job openings is also increasing. In response to this, we hope to welcome new construction management colleagues and alleviate the labor shortage in the construction industry.
